blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: RRB recruitment examinations are conducted across 21 Railway Recruitment Boards in Computer Based Test (CBT) mode.
A standard penalty of 1/3rd mark is deducted for every incorrect response in objective tests.
Normalization of marks is mandatory for multi-shift examinations to account for variation in paper difficulty.
General Awareness, Mathematics, and General Intelligence & Reasoning form the core syllabus for RRB exams.
General Science questions are directly based on Class 9 and Class 10 NCERT fundamentals.
Negative marking of 1/3rd mark applies to all objective CBT stages; avoid arbitrary guessing.
Focus heavily on NCERT Class 9 and 10 Physics, Chemistry, and Biology concepts.
Current Affairs questions predominantly cover national initiatives, schemes, and sports from the preceding 6 to 12 months.
